about: Reference configuration for the open-source identity server that the managed cloud in docs/cloud-setup.md runs (Supabase Auth, formerly GoTrue). scripts/cloud-auth-e2e.mjs reads this file so the test code names no product. {{…}} placeholders are filled in per run; every secret is generated for that run and discarded.
initSql: CREATE USER {{DB_USER}} NOINHERIT CREATEROLE LOGIN NOREPLICATION PASSWORD '{{DB_PASSWORD}}';
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS {{DB_SCHEMA}} AUTHORIZATION {{DB_USER}};
GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE postgres TO {{DB_USER}};
corsNote: A browser on another origin sends apikey and authorization; the bare server allows only content-type across origins until GOTRUE_CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS adds them. A managed cloud's API gateway already allows them; a self-run server needs this setting.
